name: future-positive-tests-d5f0d09b6f/future-negative-compilation-e.bal
reason: The case asserts compile-time rejection of incompatible future constraints, including start-action result assignments, assignments between differently constrained futures, and narrowing an unconstrained future to future<Bar>. Start actions, local declarations, functions, type definitions and the supporting record mapping constructors are supported, and no listed restriction excludes these type-compatibility checks. The invalid assignments exercise rejection within the supported type system.
test_design_notes: Five assignments are marked @error; future f5 = f1 is an unmarked widening assignment. The case requires compile-time diagnostics rather than execution.
